title: Deciding to go public; Kasparov calls for his removal

tellings.quote: The 13th World Chess Champion, Gary Kasparov, immediately began to state, "What kind of president of the World Chess Federation can Kersonen be? If he has met with aliens, he must be removed and replaced.

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, then president of a Russian republic and of the World Chess Federation, says that when he went public about meeting aliens, the former world champion Garry Kasparov demanded he be thrown out. He tells Michels about it himself, as the man it happened to: Kasparov 'immediately began to state' that anyone who had met aliens could not run world chess and 'must be removed and replaced.'
